startingActionId.description: Id of the action that executes {@link startWorkflow}

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

er.description: Execution Representation associated with this run.

spec.description: The spec that workflow was started with

outputs.description: Holds the execution outputs (sink vertices) from the synchronous execution

finallyVertexWorkflowRun.description:
The run of the workflow which executes the {@link Workflow#finallyVertex} of the workflow.
This run could be used to make sure the {@link Workflow#finallyVertex} is done executing.
The {@link Workflow#finallyVertex} execution starts before {@link SimpleSynchronousPyRun} transitions into completed, failed, or canceled state.
The output of the {@link Workflow#finallyVertex} could be retrieved using {@link SimpleSynchronousPyRun#executionResults} keyed
by `finallyVertexOutput`.

title: A specific run for a workflow.  It holds all status information about the run.
name: SimpleSynchronousPyRun
